recommendation: Keep this fix as-is. It implements the published ClaimResponse summary request for current element names without adding removed/non-current elements or broadening unrelated summary content.
issue_request: FHIR-17931 was Published/Persuasive with Modification for ClaimResponse and requested adding identifier, patient, created, billingPeriod, provider, insurer, error, and by resolution total/category/amount to the summary view.
initial_application: The 2018 Jira-tagged batch commit afb5ec66f6 partially applied the issue in the old spreadsheet, marking patient, created, insurer, total, total.category, and total.amount as summary but leaving identifier, provider/requestor, and error unset. Current source inherited that partial state.
additional_context: ClaimResponse is active in source/fhir.ini. Current source has patient renamed to subject and maps requestProvider to ClaimResponse.requestor; it has no billingPeriod or billablePeriod element to mark. Later source already marked ClaimResponse.error.code and error.expression as summary, so making the error backbone summary completes the current error summary path.
reconciliation: Added isSummary=true to ClaimResponse.identifier, ClaimResponse.requestor, and ClaimResponse.error in source/claimresponse/structuredefinition-ClaimResponse.xml. Existing summary flags already cover subject, created, insurer, total, total.category, and total.amount.
source_changes: source/claimresponse/structuredefinition-ClaimResponse.xml: added isSummary=true to ClaimResponse.requestor, the current provider/requestProvider equivalent.
source/claimresponse/structuredefinition-ClaimResponse.xml: added isSummary=true to the ClaimResponse.error backbone.

related_jiras.note: Same 2018 ClaimResponse batch changed requestProvider/provider naming; current source maps requestProvider to ClaimResponse.requestor, which is why requestor was the edited element.
Same 2018 batch included a separate Claim summary issue, but that concerns Claim rather than ClaimResponse and was not decided here.
